Byte cross-verified match-by-match, not bulk-copied from a single source. Ningbo elevated to WTA500 in 2024, replacing the cancelled Zhengzhou Open slot (WTA announcement). 4 byes into R16: Krejcikova (own top-4 seed bye, seed 4); Kasatkina and Haddad Maia (seeds 5/6, bumped up to fill Paolini/Navarro's vacated bye slots after their withdrawal); Cristian (lucky loser, inherited Zheng's vacated bye slot). Top 3 seeds (Paolini, Zheng, Navarro) withdrew without playing. Per-match dates assigned at round-day granularity (confirmed via press: R32=Mon Oct 14, R16=Wed Oct 16, QF=Fri Oct 18, SF=Sat Oct 19, F=Sun Oct 20) rather than individually verified per match, since exact intra-day match times were not sourced for every match.

WTA official scores archive (wtatennis.com/tournaments/2092/ningbo/2025/scores/), wtatennis.com news recaps ('Zhu defeats ailing Raducanu in Ningbo; Yastremska powers past Mboko'), tennis-wta.com day-by-day results, Wikipedia 2025 Ningbo Open entrant-status list, ESPN digit-decoded scoreboard cross-verification. Bracket spine verified programmatically: every round's participants trace cleanly to the prior round's winners. 4 byes into R16 (top-4 seeds, all played, no withdrawals this edition): Andreeva, Alexandrova, Rybakina, Paolini. Reigning champion Daria Kasatkina withdrew before the tournament (personal reasons, per Wikipedia) and does not appear anywhere in this draw. Two corrections made during sourcing: (1) a pasted source's Yastremska-Mboko tiebreak claim of 7-6(1) was checked against WTA's own news recap and corrected to the confirmed 7-6(3); (2) Antonia Ruzic's apparent double-loss (once to Tomljanovic, once to Kudermetova) was resolved via Wikipedia's entrant-status list confirming Ruzic entered as a lucky loser from qualifying — her loss to Tomljanovic was a qualifying-round match, excluded from this main-draw-only dataset; only the Kudermetova result (6-3 6-2, main draw R32) is included here.
